messages:
maya (prod): FYI a banking customer asked for auditor-ready exports at onboarding (day 0). They want proof they can produce evidence to auditors immediately. Need an MVP that doesn't derail our BYOK roadmap.
vincent (eng): Two options: 1) on-demand snapshot package (time-range zip with logs + trace snippets) 2) continuous export stream (heavy). Recommend (1) for MVP.
ada (infra): Agreed. MVP: pack logs into compressed archive, write to customer-provided S3 location, produce signed manifest. Keeps storage custody off Redwood.
leah (security): Must include tamper-evidence: sha256 per file, manifest signature, operator id, and keystore fingerprint if BYOK was used during encryption. Also require export request audit trail.
tom (legal): We'll need a short addendum: post-handoff custody clause, required customer attestations, and explicit notification SLA if verification fails. Also require authorized contact before release.
ben (sales): Customers will treat this as enterprise. Recommend treating day-0 export as paid add-on except for pilots. Also need a one-page explainer for SRE/SE teams.
ci-bot: infra/job create-export-pipeline queued by @vincent  ETA 1d to provision staging.
vincent (eng): Minimal API: POST /v1/tenants/:tid/exports {start_ts,end_ts,deliver_to_s3:true,customer_bucket:"s3://..."}. Worker composes archive, writes to bucket, posts manifest.json with fields: tenant_id, window, files[], checksums, signed_by, requestor.
nada (infra): If customer bucket not provided, we can stage to redwood-staging temporarily but add TTL and require POA. Hosting increases compliance burden.
leah (security): Gating checklist for pilot: manifest signature enabled, export ACLs validated, requestor POA confirmed, verification job completes successfully.
tom (legal): Add requirement: export artifacts must include a notarization field (signed_by) and retention-tier label (30d/90d/365d). We'll draft addendum language.
ben (sales): Can we estimate size before export? customers want cost estimate. We can do sampling and provide an approximate GB & price.
vincent (eng): Add a dry-run mode that returns estimated bytes and cost. Implementation estimate: ~2 backend sprints + 1 infra sprint for provisioning and docs. BYOK + escrow handshake is additional work.
maya (prod): Decision: MVP = on-demand snapshot package, HMAC-signed manifest, customer S3 preferred, dry-run cost estimate, pilot waiver for fees. BYOK deferred to roadmap. Agree?
team: +1 from eng/infra/security/legal/sales.
ci-bot: reminder  create runbook /runbooks/export-handback and incident template /runbooks/export-verification-failure.
maya (prod): Next actions: vincent RFC + RFC link by EOD, tom draft legal addendum by Wed, leah produce security checklist by Fri, ben prep SE one-pager. Pilot kickoff in 5 weeks. Closing thread.
